name: Pantry (design-led)
pitch: A recipe box and weekly meal planner. Save recipes, plan the week, get the grocery list.

baton.human: You approve the mockups, the plan and the finished screens, then deploy by hand

facts: 8 stages · 3 flows · 3 review gates · manual deploy

wip.how: Each stage shows wip used/limit. A flow never pulls a card into a full stage; the stage turns amber and the flow waits.
wip.why: Mockups and plans are cheap for AI and slow for you. Limits on Design and Plan stop a pile of unreviewed work.
wip.here: Code is full (2/2). Finished code moves to Review, which frees a slot, so reviewing is what keeps the board moving.

Code.text: Full, so the code flow pulls nothing new from Plan until a card moves on to Review.

Review.text: Its own stage, so cards waiting on you don't use the build stage's slots.

code.blurb: a test loop on each task, a review, then screenshots checked against the mockup

cards.title: Grocery list from this week's meals
cards.description: Turn the week's planned meals into one grocery list, with repeated ingredients added up.

cards.title: Scale a recipe for 2, 4 or 6 people
cards.description: Pick how many you're cooking for and every quantity in the recipe adjusts.

cards.title: Import a recipe from a URL
cards.description: Paste a link to a recipe site and Pantry pulls in the ingredients and steps, without the life story.

cards.title: Nutrition per serving
cards.description: Rough calories, protein, carbs and fat for one serving, worked out from the ingredients.

cards.title: Recipe photo gallery
cards.description: Add a few photos to a recipe and swipe through them at the top of the page.

cards.title: Weekly meal-plan calendar
cards.description: A week laid out by day and meal, with recipes dragged into each slot.

cards.title: Recipe card redesign
cards.description: A cleaner recipe card: a big photo, the cook time up front, and ingredients you can tick off.

cards.title: Favourites and star ratings
cards.description: Star the recipes you love and rate them out of five, so the best ones float to the top.

tasks.title: Store a favourite flag and a rating per recipe
Add a star toggle to the recipe card
Sort and filter the recipe box by rating

cards.title: Search recipes by ingredient
cards.description: Type what's in the fridge and see the recipes you can make with it.

tasks.title: Match a search against ingredient names
Rank recipes by how many ingredients you have
Add the search box to the recipe box

cards.title: Shopping list grouping
cards.description: Group the grocery list so a trip round the shop goes in one pass.
cards.question: Group by store aisle, or by recipe?

cards.title: Cook mode: big text, screen stays on
cards.description: A step-at-a-time view in large type that keeps the screen awake while your hands are floury.

cards.title: Recipe tags as chips
cards.description: Show a recipe's tags as tappable chips that filter the recipe box.

cards.title: Print-friendly recipe page
cards.description: Print a recipe on one clean page, without the menus and buttons.

cards.title: Add a recipe
cards.description: Save a recipe with its ingredients and steps.

cards.title: Recipe page
cards.description: Each recipe gets its own page with ingredients on one side and steps on the other.

cards.title: Tags and filters
cards.description: Tag recipes (quick, veggie, batch-cook) and filter the recipe box by tag.
